message.reasoning_content: We need to determine criminal charge(s) based on facts: forging official seals (company seals, financial seals, legal representative's seal). In Chinese criminal law, forging official seals is a crime under "伪造印章罪" (counterfeiting seals). Also possibly "非法制造、买卖、提供伪造的印章罪". The fact: He commissioned a counterfeit seal maker, provided text, and got forged seals. He is a "伪造印章罪" (forgery of seals). Also maybe "非法提供印章罪". Under Chinese law, Article 280 of Criminal Law: "伪造、变造国家机关印章、公司、企业、事业单位、人民团体印章的，处三年以下有期徒刑、拘役或者管制，并处罚金；情节严重的，处三年以上七年以下有期徒刑，并处罚金。" Also "非法提供印章罪" maybe separate: "非法提供印章罪" is also in law: providing forged seals to others. The defendant is the one who commissioned and obtained the seals, not the maker. He is the buyer. The crime could be "伪造印章罪" (forgery) or "非法提供印章罪". The facts: He "以人民币300元的价格...联系办理假印章贩子，提供欲刻印的印章印文，私刻了...". He is the one who had them made. So he is the forger? He didn't physically forge but commissioned. Under law, both the maker and the user can be liable for forging. The typical charge is "伪造印章罪". So answer: [罪名]伪造印章罪<eoa>.
